experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, home to Cinderella Castle, Space Mountain, and the beloved parade. Arrive early afternoon on Day 2 to maximize time after a late Day 1 arrival. Stay on-site at Disney's Contemporary Resort or Disney's Polynesian Village Resort, both within walking distance or a short monorail ride, eliminating transit time and letting the family dive straight into the magic.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista, Walt Disney World Resort

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, a living cultural festival featuring 11 country pavilions with authentic cuisine, entertainment, and artisan crafts. Sample dishes from Mexico, Japan, France, and Morocco all in one afternoon. Staying at Disney's BoardWalk Inn or Disney's Beach Club Resort places you within a short walk or boat ride to EPCOT's International Gateway entrance, saving time and transport costs.
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse the family in the cinematic world of Hollywood Studios, highlighted by the fully interactive Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge land. Build a custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop, pilot the Millennium Falcon, and experience Rise of the Resistance. Disney's Art of Animation Resort and Disney's Pop Century Resort are directly connected via the Disney Skyliner gondola, offering a fast, fun, and cost-free commute straight to the park.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Wind down a mid-week evening at Disney Springs, Disney's free-to-enter shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or Rainforest Cafe, catch a live street performance, and browse unique Disney merchandise. No park ticket required, making it a budget-friendly evening option. Hotels like Disney's Saratoga Springs Resort are directly connected to Disney Springs via walking path, ideal for a relaxed family night out.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Walt Disney World Resort

experiences.name: Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage
experiences.description: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see live African wildlife roaming open savanna, then soar over Pandora on the breathtaking Flight of Passage ride in the Avatar-themed land. This park is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active and ride queues are shorter. Disney's All-Star Resorts and Disney's Coronado Springs Resort offer affordable on-site lodging with direct Disney bus service to Animal Kingdom, keeping the family close to all activity hubs throughout the week.
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Bay Lake, Walt Disney World Resort

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Walt Disney World Resort Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: No morning activities — flight arrives at 13:00. Rest and travel time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Take Disney's Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Uber/Lyft) to Walt Disney World Resort. Check in to your boutique stay, unpack, and get oriented with the resort map and app. Download the My Disney Experience app to set up Lightning Lanes and check wait times. Head to Disney Springs (free admission) for an afternoon of browsing shops, street entertainment, and live music.
day_by_day.evening: Explore Disney Springs further — catch a live outdoor performance or street performer show. Walk around the waterfront area and enjoy the festive atmosphere. Browse the World of Disney store for souvenirs. Wrap up the evening with a relaxed stroll before heading back to rest and plan the week ahead.

meals.breakfast: Eat before or during the flight / grab a snack at the airport.
meals.lunch: Grab a quick and affordable bite at Disney Springs — try Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri for budget-friendly chicken tenders and sandwiches (~$12–15 per person).
meals.dinner: Earl of Sandwich at Disney Springs — one of the best budget dining options on Disney property. Hot sandwiches, salads, and desserts for around $10–13 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is intentionally light. Use this time to rest, get your bearings, and charge devices. Pick up a refillable resort mug if your hotel offers one — it pays for itself quickly. Disney Springs is free to enter and a great low-key introduction to the magic.

day_by_day.morning: Arrive at Magic Kingdom at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland to ride TRON Lightcycle / Run and Space Mountain before crowds build. Use the My Disney Experience app to snag Lightning Lane passes for popular rides. Explore Fantasyland and ride Peter Pan's Flight, The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Lightning Lane if available).
day_by_day.afternoon: After lunch, visit Adventureland — ride Pirates of the Caribbean and Jungle Cruise. Take a midday break during peak heat (typically 12:00–3:00 PM) by enjoying indoor attractions like Walt Disney's Carousel of Progress or The Hall of Presidents. Revisit Tomorrowland for Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin. Check the app for parade times — catch the afternoon parade on Main Street U.S.A.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks show at Magic Kingdom (typically around 9:00 PM in summer). Grab a prime viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. about 30–45 minutes early. Ride a few lower-wait attractions in the evening when crowds thin out. Exit the park after fireworks and use Disney transportation back to your resort.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at your resort's food court or a continental option to save money before the park. Budget: ~$8–10.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — one of Magic Kingdom's best-value counter service spots. Try the lobster roll or fried fish basket. ~$12–15 per person.
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — large portions, burgers, chicken, and rotisserie options. Budget-friendly at ~$12–14 per person. Eat an early dinner (5:00–6:00 PM) to avoid the dinner rush.

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is the most iconic park — perfect for Day 2 energy. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a refillable water bottle (free water is available at any quick-service location). June weather in Orlando is hot and humid — expect afternoon thunderstorms. Bring a small poncho. Arrive 30 minutes before official park opening for the best experience.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT at rope drop. Start with World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane required — set this up the moment the park opens). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE (Green Mission for a milder experience). Explore World Nature — ride Soarin' Around the World with a Lightning Lane if possible.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring EPCOT's World Showcase, which opens at 11:00 AM. Walk through the international pavilions (Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, Canada). Enjoy free cultural entertainment, live performances, and browse each country's unique merchandise. Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion (Lightning Lane recommended). Visit the aquarium in the Mexico pavilion — it's free with park admission.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule for 2027). Watch from the World Showcase promenade for the best views. Grab a dessert treat from one of the international pavilion kiosks to enjoy during the show. Head back to the resort after the show.

meals.breakfast: Eat at your resort food court before heading out. Budget: ~$8–10.
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — one of EPCOT's best counter-service restaurants with fresh, affordable options including grain bowls, sandwiches, and Asian-inspired dishes. ~$12–15 per person.
meals.dinner: Yorkshire County Fish Shop in the UK Pavilion — authentic fish and chips at a very reasonable price (~$10–13). Eat outside by the lagoon for a lovely atmosphere. Alternatively, grab food from the World Showcase international food kiosks for a fun, budget-friendly mix-and-match dinner.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive — wear the most comfortable shoes you own. The World Showcase is a cultural treasure and largely free to explore. Many pavilions have free films and exhibits. For Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind, join the virtual queue at exactly 7:00 AM (when it opens) or 1:00 PM through the My Disney Experience app — it fills up instantly.

day_by_day.morning: Take a mid-trip rest morning — sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. This is a great day to use the resort pool, which is included with your stay. Relax, recharge, and let feet recover. Around 11:00 AM, head to Disney's Hollywood Studios for an afternoon and evening visit (purchasing a park-hopper or single-day ticket as needed).
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Hollywood Studios around noon. Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run (walk-up standby) and Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (Lightning Lane highly recommended — book it the moment you enter the park). Explore Galaxy's Edge and browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities. Ride Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land (Lightning Lane if available, or ride during evening when waits drop).
day_by_day.evening: Catch the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular nighttime fireworks show (check 2027 schedule). Watch from the Chinese Theatre area or near the central hub. Before the show, ride Tower of Terror or Rock 'n' Roller Coaster for a thrilling evening. Explore Sunset Boulevard atmosphere and street entertainment. Return to resort after the show.

meals.breakfast: Relaxed breakfast at the resort food court — take your time. Budget: ~$8–10.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — a beloved and affordable counter-service spot. Try the grilled cheese or BBQ brisket melt with a Lunch Box Tart for dessert. ~$12–14 per person.
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary in Hollywood Studios — budget-friendly burgers, wraps, and flatbreads in a fun Hollywood theme. ~$12–15 per person. Alternatively, grab a snack from a street cart and save money for a resort dinner.

day_by_day.notes: The half-day rest is intentional — Disney fatigue is real, especially in June heat. Use the morning pool time wisely. Hollywood Studios is best experienced in the afternoon and evening when some crowds thin after the midday heat peak. Rise of the Resistance is a must-do — it's one of the most immersive theme park experiences ever created. Book Lightning Lane early.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Disney's Animal Kingdom at rope drop. Go directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar — ride Avatar Flight of Passage first thing (Lightning Lane essential — book it immediately upon entering). Then ride Na'vi River Journey. Explore the stunning Pandora landscape and bioluminescent details. Head to Africa — ride Kilimanjaro Safaris early morning when animals are most active.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the safari, explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail (free walking trail with gorillas, hippos, and exotic birds). Head to Asia — ride Expedition Everest (one of Disney's best coasters). Visit the Maharajah Jungle Trek walking trail. Check the show schedule for Festival of the Lion King in Africa — one of Disney's best live shows (no extra cost, included with admission). Catch a performance in the afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Animal Kingdom's Rivers of Light nighttime show or check the 2027 schedule for the current evening spectacular. Explore Discovery Island as the park lights up at dusk. Visit the Tree of Life and look for the 325 animal carvings. Enjoy the Tree of Life Awakening projections on the tree after dark. Head back to resort for a well-earned rest.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick snack at the resort or a granola bar on the go to make rope drop.
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — widely regarded as one of Disney's best counter-service restaurants. Smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating. ~$14–17 per person (worth the slight splurge).
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Local Food Cafes (counter service, not the table service restaurant) in Asia — affordable Asian-inspired dishes including teriyaki bowls and egg rolls. ~$11–14 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is a morning park — animals are most active early, and the heat becomes intense by midday. Kilimanjaro Safaris is best ridden at rope drop or in the late afternoon. Bring insect repellent — the park has lush vegetation and bugs can be present. The park often closes earlier than other parks, so check hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park for any missed rides or experiences (Magic Kingdom or Hollywood Studios recommended for a second visit). Alternatively, use this morning for a Disney Resort hotel-hopping experience — take Disney buses or the monorail to visit the Grand Floridian, Polynesian, or Contemporary Resort lobbies, which are free to explore. The Grand Floridian lobby is stunning and features live piano music. Browse resort gift shops for unique souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at Disney's Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach water park (separate ticket required — check for discounts bundled with your resort stay). These are excellent budget-friendly ways to cool off in June heat. Slides, lazy rivers, and wave pools provide hours of entertainment. Alternatively, return to EPCOT's World Showcase to explore any pavilions you missed and try more international foods.
day_by_day.evening: Final full evening at Disney Springs — enjoy the free entertainment, street performers, and atmosphere. Browse World of Disney for last-minute souvenirs. Treat yourself to a Ghirardelli sundae or a Sprinkles cupcake as a trip celebration. Watch the sunset over the waterfront and enjoy the festive evening ambiance. Return to resort for packing and rest.

meals.breakfast: Resort food court breakfast — fuel up for the day. Budget: ~$8–10.
meals.lunch: If at a water park, grab food from the park's counter service (hot dogs, burgers, nachos — ~$10–13). If at EPCOT, revisit a World Showcase pavilion for a fun international lunch.
meals.dinner: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers at reasonable prices with creative toppings. ~$13–16 per person. Or try Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza for a budget-friendly customizable pizza option (~$10–12).

day_by_day.notes: Day 6 is intentionally flexible — use it to revisit favorites, catch anything missed, or simply relax. Water park tickets can sometimes be purchased at a discount through AAA, Disney's official website bundles, or third-party ticket resellers. Check in advance. If you have a park hopper pass, use it today to maximize value.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning at Walt Disney World. Check out of the resort (store luggage at the bell desk if your flight is later). Take one final walk through the resort grounds or visit the hotel lobby for last photos. If time permits, take the monorail loop around the Seven Seas Lagoon for a free and scenic farewell view of Magic Kingdom's Cinderella Castle from the water. Pick up any last souvenirs at the resort gift shop.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the airport with plenty of time — allow 2–3 hours before your flight for Orlando International Airport. Take a rideshare (Uber/Lyft) or Disney transportation to the airport. Reflect on the magical week and review your favorite memories. Browse airport shops for any forgotten souvenirs (though prices are higher at the airport).
day_by_day.evening: Departure. Safe travels home with magical memories from Walt Disney World!

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy a sit-down meal or grab something quick from the food court. Budget: ~$8–12. Alternatively, use any remaining snack credits or resort mug refills.
meals.lunch: Grab lunch at the airport or eat before departing the resort area. Landry's Seafood or a quick-service option near the airport. Budget: ~$12–15.
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or dinner at your destination.

day_by_day.notes: Check out time is typically 11:00 AM — confirm with your resort. Bell services will store your luggage for free so you can enjoy the morning without hauling bags. Leave a buffer of at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight given Orlando airport security and Disney transportation times. Take a moment on your last morning to soak it all in — Disney magic is best appreciated slowly.

day_by_day.morning: Flight arrives at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Use arrival time to collect luggage, arrange Disney's Magical Express or rideshare transfer to Walt Disney World Resort, and check in to your boutique stay.
day_by_day.afternoon: After settling into the hotel, take a leisurely stroll around Disney Springs for a first taste of the magic. Browse the shops, pick up Disney merchandise, and soak in the atmosphere without the pressure of a full park day. Visit the LEGO Store and World of Disney flagship store.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening — catch a live street performance, browse the entertainment district, and have dinner at a mid-range restaurant along the waterfront promenade. End the night early to rest up for the week ahead.

meals.breakfast: Grab a snack or light meal at the airport before landing.
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at Disney Springs upon arrival — try Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza or D-Luxe Burger for an affordable and tasty welcome meal.
meals.dinner: Splitsville Luxury Lanes at Disney Springs — enjoy American comfort food like flatbreads, burgers, and sushi rolls in a lively, family-friendly setting. Budget approx. $20–$35 per adult.

day_by_day.notes: Do not schedule anything before 13:00. Use this afternoon as a soft landing day. Download the My Disney Experience app and set up Lightning Lane preferences for the week. Purchase any remaining park tickets if not already done.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then cross to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane if available. Visit Cinderella Castle and explore Adventureland (Pirates of the Caribbean, Jungle Cruise).
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue through Magic Kingdom — enjoy Liberty Square (Haunted Mansion), Frontierland (Big Thunder Mountain Railroad), and catch the afternoon Festival of Fantasy parade. Take a midday break at the hotel if needed, as park hours often extend late.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the enchanting nighttime spectacular — Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (check current show schedule). Ride any remaining attractions with shorter evening queues before park close.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at your hotel — most Disney boutique resort hotels offer a buffet or grab-and-go option. Budget approx. $15–$20 per person.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — a mid-range quick-service spot with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fried fish. Budget approx. $15–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street, U.S.A. — a classic table-service option with sandwiches, pasta, and American fare. Make a reservation via My Disney Experience. Budget approx. $25–$40 per adult.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Genie+ or individual Lightning Lane selections in advance for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and TRON Lightcycle Run. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen — June temperatures in Orlando can reach 90°F+ with high humidity. Arrive at the park 30 minutes before official opening.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Arrive at rope drop and head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Book your Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run boarding group or Lightning Lane first thing. Explore Batuu, visit Oga's Cantina (reservation recommended), and build a lightsaber at Savi's Workshop if desired (extra cost, approx. $249.99).
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (top priority attraction — use Lightning Lane). Then explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Alien Swirling Saucers), Rock 'n' Roller Coaster, and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Fantasmic! nighttime lagoon spectacular at Hollywood Studios (check show times). This 30-minute outdoor show features Mickey Mouse, beloved Disney characters, and stunning water and fire effects — a true highlight of the week.

meals.breakfast: Early grab-and-go from the hotel or resort food court to make rope drop.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — a beloved quick-service spot with toasted sandwiches, potato barrels, and specialty lemonade. Budget approx. $12–$18 per person.
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant — a unique mid-range table-service experience where you dine in vintage cars under a simulated starry night sky watching classic sci-fi movie clips. Budget approx. $25–$40 per adult. Reservation required.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the most popular parks — early arrival is critical. Fantasmic! seating fills up fast; arrive 45–60 minutes early for good spots. Check the My Disney Experience app for real-time wait times and show schedules throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Start at EPCOT's Future World (now called World Discovery/World Nature/World Celebration) and ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane required) and Test Track. Then transition into World Showcase as it opens around 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the heart of the day exploring EPCOT's World Showcase — sample authentic cuisine and snacks from pavilions including Mexico (tacos, margaritas), Japan (sushi, mochi), France (crêpes, macarons), and Morocco. Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT Forever or the current EPCOT nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current schedule). Enjoy a final leisurely walk through the remaining pavilions — United Kingdom, Canada, and America — before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast to fuel up before the full EPCOT day.
meals.lunch: World Showcase grazing — budget $30–$50 per person for snacks and small plates across multiple pavilions: a crepe from France, a school bread from Norway, and a taco from Mexico make a fantastic progressive lunch.
meals.dinner: La Hacienda de San Angel (Mexico Pavilion, lakeside table-service) — enjoy authentic Mexican cuisine including fajitas, enchiladas, and margaritas with a gorgeous view of World Showcase Lagoon. Budget approx. $30–$50 per adult. Reservation recommended.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is ideal for food lovers and culture enthusiasts. If visiting during a festival (EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival runs June–November), expect additional food booths and entertainment throughout the park. Pace yourself with the World Showcase grazing — it's easy to overspend on snacks.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage — Arrive at rope drop and go directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Avatar: Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride with very high wait times — Lightning Lane strongly recommended). Explore the bioluminescent world of Pandora and ride Na'vi River Journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the Harambe Wildlife Reserve for Kilimanjaro Safaris — the best time for animal activity is morning to early afternoon. See giraffes, elephants, lions, and more roaming open savanna. Explore Africa and Asia on foot, then ride Expedition Everest in Asia and DINOSAUR in DinoLand U.S.A.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the Tree of Life Awakening — a stunning projection show on Animal Kingdom's iconic 145-foot Tree of Life that runs after dark (check park closing hours, as Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks). Return to Disney Springs for a relaxed evening dinner if time allows.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the hotel or grab a snack at the Animal Kingdom entrance area.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — a quick-service gem with rice and noodle bowls, cheeseburger pods, and fresh ingredients. One of the best quick-service meals in Walt Disney World. Budget approx. $15–$22 per person.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Animal Kingdom's Asia section — a mid-range table-service restaurant with pan-Asian cuisine including crispy honey chicken, ahi tuna nachos, and fried wontons. Budget approx. $25–$40 per adult. Reservation recommended.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom typically has earlier closing hours (often 8:00–9:00 PM in summer). Plan your day accordingly. The park is very walkable and lush — comfortable footwear is essential. June heat is intense; bring water bottles and take shade breaks during peak afternoon hours (1:00–3:00 PM).

day_by_day.morning: Flex / Resort Day & Return to a Favorite Park — Use this day to revisit your favorite park from earlier in the week, catch any attractions you missed, or enjoy a relaxed morning at the resort. Many Disney boutique resort hotels feature pools with waterslides, hot tubs, and poolside bars — perfect for a mid-trip recharge.
day_by_day.afternoon: If returning to a park, use afternoon hours to tackle any remaining bucket-list attractions with shorter wait times (many guests leave parks mid-afternoon). Alternatively, explore Disney's BoardWalk — a free-to-access entertainment district with street performers, restaurants, and carnival-style games along a lakeside promenade.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening — Return to Disney Springs for a more thorough exploration. Catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 movie theater, or enjoy live music at Raglan Road Irish Pub. This is a great low-key evening before the final full park day.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely breakfast at the resort — treat yourself to a sit-down meal at your hotel's restaurant to celebrate the midpoint of the trip.
meals.lunch: Chef Art Smith's Homecomin' at Disney Springs — Southern comfort food including fried chicken, hush puppies, and moonshine cocktails. A beloved mid-range dining experience. Budget approx. $20–$35 per adult.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — an upscale-casual waterfront restaurant with fresh seafood, prime steaks, and an impressive raw bar. Budget approx. $35–$60 per adult. Reservation strongly recommended.

day_by_day.notes: Saturday is typically one of the busiest days at Walt Disney World as local and weekend visitors arrive. If visiting a park, prioritize Lightning Lane purchases and arrive early. Disney's BoardWalk and Disney Springs are free to access and do not require park tickets.

day_by_day.morning: Final Morning Magic — Check out of the resort (or arrange late checkout if available). Spend a final morning at Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for any last must-do attractions. Many guests find Sunday mornings slightly less crowded before the weekend rush fully builds. Pick up any last-minute souvenirs at the park or Disney Springs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Departure Preparation — Return to the resort, collect luggage, and arrange transportation to Orlando International Airport (MCO). Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for travel, check-in, and security. Disney's Magical Express (or alternative resort-to-airport transport) should be booked in advance.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando — Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic, family memories, and world-class entertainment. If your flight is late evening, enjoy a final meal at the airport or a nearby restaurant before heading home.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy a full hot breakfast at your hotel before checkout. Many Disney resort restaurants offer character dining experiences (book in advance) for a magical farewell meal.
meals.lunch: Quick-service meal at your chosen park or a grab-and-go option near the resort before heading to the airport. Try Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn and Café (Magic Kingdom) or Connections Café (EPCOT) for a quick, affordable farewell bite. Budget approx. $12–$18 per person.
meals.dinner: Airport dining at MCO or an early dinner before departure — Orlando International Airport has a solid selection of restaurants including The Hemisphere Bar & Grill and Vino Volo wine bar in the terminals.

day_by_day.notes: Check Disney's official app for any park reservation requirements on the final day. Return any rented strollers or mobility equipment. Ensure all Disney PhotoPass purchases are downloaded before leaving the resort area. Consider purchasing a Disney gift card for future trips — they never expire and can be used across all Disney properties.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

hotel.name: Walt Disney World Resort Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, home to Cinderella Castle, Space Mountain, and the beloved parade. Arrive early afternoon on Day 2 to maximize time after a late Day 1 arrival. Stay on-site at Disney's Contemporary Resort or Disney's Polynesian Village Resort, both within walking distance or a short monorail ride, eliminating transit time and letting the family dive straight into the magic.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista, Walt Disney World Resort

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, a living cultural festival featuring 11 country pavilions with authentic cuisine, entertainment, and artisan crafts. Sample dishes from Mexico, Japan, France, and Morocco all in one afternoon. Staying at Disney's BoardWalk Inn or Disney's Beach Club Resort places you within a short walk or boat ride to EPCOT's International Gateway entrance, saving time and transport costs.
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse the family in the cinematic world of Hollywood Studios, highlighted by the fully interactive Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge land. Build a custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop, pilot the Millennium Falcon, and experience Rise of the Resistance. Disney's Art of Animation Resort and Disney's Pop Century Resort are directly connected via the Disney Skyliner gondola, offering a fast, fun, and cost-free commute straight to the park.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Wind down a mid-week evening at Disney Springs, Disney's free-to-enter shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or Rainforest Cafe, catch a live street performance, and browse unique Disney merchandise. No park ticket required, making it a budget-friendly evening option. Hotels like Disney's Saratoga Springs Resort are directly connected to Disney Springs via walking path, ideal for a relaxed family night out.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Walt Disney World Resort

experiences.name: Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage
experiences.description: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see live African wildlife roaming open savanna, then soar over Pandora on the breathtaking Flight of Passage ride in the Avatar-themed land. This park is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active and ride queues are shorter. Disney's All-Star Resorts and Disney's Coronado Springs Resort offer affordable on-site lodging with direct Disney bus service to Animal Kingdom, keeping the family close to all activity hubs throughout the week.
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Bay Lake, Walt Disney World Resort

day_by_day.morning: Flight arrives at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Private luxury transfer from Orlando International Airport to Walt Disney World Resort via pre-arranged Disney Magical Express or private car service.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check in early at Walt Disney World Resort Boutique Stay and enjoy a resort orientation. Explore the hotel grounds, pool, and amenities. Visit Disney Springs for a leisurely stroll, light shopping at World of Disney, and a chance to decompress after travel.
day_by_day.evening: Attend the Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening — enjoy live entertainment, browse upscale boutiques, and soak in the vibrant atmosphere along the waterfront. Perfect low-key introduction to the Disney World experience.

meals.breakfast: Enjoyed before or during the flight — no breakfast scheduled on-site.
meals.lunch: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship pan-Asian restaurant featuring premium dim sum, Peking duck, and signature cocktails in a stunning two-story setting.
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — upscale waterfront dining with fresh seafood, prime steaks, and a spectacular view of the marina. Try the whole Maine lobster or dry-aged tomahawk ribeye.

day_by_day.notes: Request early check-in in advance. Activate your MagicBand+ upon arrival and download the My Disney Experience app. Pre-book Lightning Lane Multi Pass for the rest of the week. Keep the afternoon relaxed to recover from travel.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Arrive at rope drop (park opening) to experience the most iconic rides with minimal wait times. Ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Space Mountain, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad first using Lightning Lane Individual selections. Explore Fantasyland and meet characters at the Royal Hall.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — enjoy Tomorrowland, Pirates of the Caribbean, and the Haunted Mansion. Take a mid-afternoon break at the resort pool if needed, leveraging the park-hopper pass to return refreshed. Use Lightning Lane passes strategically for top-tier attractions.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular Magic Kingdom nighttime shows — TRON Lightcycle Run (if available as evening attraction), followed by the Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle. A truly unmissable premium Disney experience.

meals.breakfast: Cinderella's Royal Table — a character dining experience inside Cinderella Castle. Book the earliest seating for a fairy-tale breakfast with Disney Princesses. Reservation required well in advance.
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland — dine inside the Beast's enchanted castle. Order the French onion soup and braised pork for a theatrical mid-day meal.
meals.dinner: Skipper Canteen in Adventureland — quirky, story-rich dining with globally inspired dishes in a lush, explorer-themed setting. Try the sustainable fish or Jungle Juice mocktail.

day_by_day.notes: Arrive 30–45 minutes before park opening for rope drop advantage. Book Cinderella's Royal Table 60 days in advance — it books out instantly. Purchase Lightning Lane Individual for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and TRON Lightcycle Run separately for guaranteed access.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Begin with Rise of the Resistance (book boarding group or Lightning Lane at park open). Explore Black Spire Outpost, build a custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop (reservation required), and pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue through Hollywood Studios — experience Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Alien Swirling Saucers), Tower of Terror, and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular afternoon show for an immersive live performance.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Fantasmic! nighttime spectacular at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater — secure premium Fantasmic! Dining Package seating through a restaurant reservation that includes guaranteed show seats. Cap the night with a walk through Galaxy's Edge illuminated at dusk.

meals.breakfast: Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge — a unique, immersive bar experience with exotic Star Wars-themed beverages and light bites. Opens early and fills up fast; reservations essential.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — themed quick-service with surprisingly excellent dishes like Felucian Garden Spread and Smoked Kaadu Ribs. Grab a window seat for full immersion.
meals.dinner: Hollywood & Vine — character dining with Disney Junior characters (great for younger family members). Enjoy a premium buffet with carved meats, fresh seafood, and decadent desserts while characters visit your table.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building costs approximately $250 per lightsaber and must be reserved in advance — a truly premium, memorable keepsake. Droid Depot is a less expensive alternative. Fantasmic! Dining Package must be booked through Disney Dining at least 60 days out.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Begin in Future World (now called World Discovery and World Nature) with Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (Virtual Queue or Lightning Lane) and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion. Explore the stunning new EPCOT redesign.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on a self-guided premium World Showcase culinary and cultural tour — sample signature dishes and beverages at the Japan, Morocco, Italy, Germany, and Canada pavilions. Enjoy live cultural performances and artisan demonstrations throughout the showcase promenade.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's HARMONIOUS or the current nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of the largest nighttime shows ever created for a Disney park. Secure a premium lagoon-side viewing spot near the Italy or America pavilions at least 45 minutes early.

meals.breakfast: Spice Road Table at the Morocco Pavilion — Mediterranean-inspired breakfast mezze with stunning lagoon views. A hidden gem for a relaxed, scenic morning meal.
meals.lunch: Monsieur Paul at the France Pavilion — EPCOT's most acclaimed fine dining restaurant, inspired by legendary chef Paul Bocuse. Features classic French cuisine with modern refinement; prix-fixe lunch menu available.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo at the Japan Pavilion — theatrical teppanyaki-style dinner with skilled chefs preparing premium wagyu beef, lobster, and seasonal vegetables tableside. Reserve well in advance.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most food-forward park in Disney World — budget extra for World Showcase snacking. Consider the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival if visiting during that period (typically August–November). The France Pavilion bakery (Boulangerie Patisserie Les Halles) is excellent for pastry snacks.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage — Start with Flight of Passage in Pandora: The World of Avatar immediately at rope drop (Lightning Lane Individual highly recommended). The soaring banshee ride is widely considered the best attraction in all of Walt Disney World.
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience the Kilimanjaro Safaris — a 30-minute open-air expedition through authentic African savanna habitats with live lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, and more. Explore Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail on foot and visit the Maharajah Jungle Trek for tigers and giant fruit bats. Catch the Festival of the Lion King live stage show.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular (or current equivalent) at Animal Kingdom before the park closes. Return to the resort for a relaxing evening at the hotel spa or private pool area.

meals.breakfast: Tusker House Restaurant — Donald Duck character breakfast with African-inspired buffet including bobotie, carved meats, fresh fruit, and specialty pastries. A fan-favorite character dining experience.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — the best quick-service restaurant in Disney World. Build your own bowl with premium proteins like slow-roasted Rongi wood-smoked beef or sustainable fish with vibrant grain or vegetable bases.
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Disney's most sophisticated park restaurant, featuring globally inspired cuisine celebrating world travel. Multi-course tasting menu available. Try the sustainable whole fish, braised short rib, or the signature Tiffins cocktail.

day_by_day.notes: Book Flight of Passage Lightning Lane Individual at exactly 7:00 AM on the day of your visit — it sells out within minutes. The Pandora area is most magical at dusk when bioluminescent plants glow. Tiffins requires a reservation and is considered one of the finest dining experiences in all of Walt Disney World.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated resort relaxation and luxury amenity day — sleep in and enjoy a leisurely morning at the Walt Disney World Resort Boutique Stay. Book a treatment at the resort spa (massage, facial, or couples treatment). Enjoy the private pool, concierge-curated activities, or a guided resort experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for a park-hopper afternoon — use this day to revisit favorite attractions, catch anything missed earlier in the week, or explore new areas. Alternatively, enjoy a round of golf at one of Disney's championship courses (Magnolia, Palm, or Lake Buena Vista courses — reservations required).
day_by_day.evening: Premium VIP Tour Experience — book a private Disney VIP Tour Guide (available through Disney's VIP Tour Services) for an exclusive after-hours or evening experience with front-of-line access to all major attractions across any park. This is the ultimate luxury Disney experience.

meals.breakfast: In-room resort breakfast — arrange a premium private breakfast delivery or room service through the resort concierge with fresh pastries, artisan coffee, fresh-squeezed juices, and seasonal fruit.
meals.lunch: California Grill atop Disney's Contemporary Resort — panoramic views of Magic Kingdom and Seven Seas Lagoon with a sophisticated California wine country menu. Request a window table for the Magic Kingdom fireworks view in the evening.
meals.dinner: Victoria & Albert's at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa — Walt Disney World's most exclusive and celebrated restaurant. A multi-course prix-fixe dinner featuring world-class ingredients, tableside preparations, and an extraordinary wine program. Black-tie optional; reservations open 60 days in advance and are extremely limited.

day_by_day.notes: Victoria & Albert's is one of the finest restaurants in all of Florida and requires formal attire (no children under 10 permitted). A dinner here can run $350–$500+ per person with wine pairings. Disney VIP Tours cost approximately $450–$900 per hour (minimum 7 hours) but include unlimited Lightning Lane access — worth every dollar for a luxury family trip.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning at Walt Disney World — enjoy a leisurely resort breakfast and pack up. Take a final stroll through Disney Springs for last-minute premium souvenirs, artisan gifts, and character merchandise. Visit the Marketplace Co-Op or Arribas Brothers for bespoke keepsakes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure flight time, enjoy one final park visit or resort activity. Consider the Disney's Fantasia Gardens Miniature Golf for a fun, low-intensity family farewell activity. Alternatively, revisit a favorite park for a final ride on a beloved attraction.
day_by_day.evening: Private luxury transfer back to Orlando International Airport. Arrange lounge access or premium check-in services through your airline. Reflect on an extraordinary week of Disney magic.

meals.breakfast: 1900 Park Fare at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort — a beloved character breakfast with Cinderella, Prince Charming, and the stepsisters. Lavish buffet in a stunning Victorian carousel setting — a perfect fairy-tale farewell.
meals.lunch: Chef Art Smith's Homecomin' at Disney Springs — Southern-inspired comfort cuisine by celebrity chef Art Smith. Try the fried chicken and doughnuts, deviled eggs, and hummingbird cake. A warm, celebratory send-off meal.
meals.dinner: Airport or in-flight dining — arrange premium lounge dining at MCO or enjoy first-class in-flight service on Lufthansa.

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout from the resort concierge to maximize your final morning without rushing. Store luggage with the bell services team if needed. Tip your resort concierge, housekeeping, and any personal guides generously — they make the luxury experience possible. Consider mailing large souvenir purchases home to avoid baggage fees.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
